fields.statement: QA cycle 1, hands-on with a scratch build of 9402a003 in a scratch root (RHIZA_ROOT etc. unset): rhiza root init root wrote root/rhiza.toml (exit 0); a second root init on it exited 2 with next: rhiza root show; root show --json gave the same root from the root, from a registered project's subfolder app/sub and from a git worktree sibling app.feature-x.

QA cycle 1, hands-on with a scratch build of 9402a003 in a scratch root (RHIZA_ROOT etc. unset): rhiza root show --json gave project "" at the root itself, project app in app/sub and in the app.feature-x sibling worktree, project "" in an unregistered folder under the root, and outside any root exited 2 with next: rhiza root init.

QA cycle 1, hands-on with a scratch build of 9402a003 in a scratch root (RHIZA_ROOT etc. unset): rhiza project add app registered app with its repo ID (app had .rhiza/); project add bare --name plain registered plain without a repo; rhiza.toml listed both; an outside path, nested/deep, a non-git folder and a duplicate name each exited 2 with a next.

QA cycle 1, hands-on with a scratch build of 9402a003 in a scratch root (RHIZA_ROOT etc. unset): rhiza project add file://<bare>.git cloned into <root>/src and registered it (project ls shows it); a bad file:// URL exited 2 with the git error and a next and left rhiza.toml byte-identical; cloning into an existing folder (--name notgit) exited 2 with a next.

QA cycle 1, hands-on with a scratch build of 9402a003 in a scratch root (RHIZA_ROOT etc. unset): rhiza project ls (text and --json) listed app initialised with its repo ID and plain not initialised; project rm src2 unregistered it and left src2/ on disk; project rm ghost exited 2 with next: rhiza project ls.

QA cycle 1, hands-on with a scratch build of 9402a003 in a scratch root (RHIZA_ROOT etc. unset): In an unregistered repo under the root, rhiza request and run start --dry-run exited 2 with next: rhiza project add <path>; in a repo under no root, rhiza request exited 2 with next: rhiza root init; rhiza check (after render) passed in both; rhiza request in registered project app queued a feature request.
